notes: Limits are derived as ceil(worst recorded value / (1 + local tolerance)), rounded up to a round number; run `tools/check_test_cost_budgets --suggest` against fresh recordings and paste its output (including provenance) rather than hand-picking a number.
Sample: 8 recordings from host athena, 2026-08-10 15:21Z-17:46Z, 4-14 workers, 28,380-28,470 nodes.

`collection_seconds` and `collection_cpu_seconds` are per-worker limits (each xdist worker collects the whole suite, so the recorded summary sum is divided by the worker count before comparison); every other summary and cause entry is a suite-wide total.
`peak_worker_rss_kib` is the peak of a worker's RSS curve sampled across the run, not the curve's post-collection reading (~520 MiB), which is stable and much lower.
Raising a limit requires a fresh `just test-cost` recording plus `tools/check_test_cost_budgets --suggest` output — do not raise a limit to hide a one-off regression.
